sourceRegionProfiles.literalSupport: Exclude every body triangle incident to any positive ipsilateral upperarm-or-descendant weight. A documented stray weight also excludes opposite-hand faces; do not claim all opposite-arm surfaces retained.
sourceRegionProfiles.sourceHalfSpace: Union of all positive upperarm-or-descendant support, closed over incident faces. Exclude only faces strictly within the ipsilateral source-rest x half-space. Retain all68 midline-touching faces and all opposite-half-space faces as obstacles. This still excludes some ipsilateral mixed torso faces; it is a declared source region, not anatomical truth.

positiveBound.semantics: Every selected query/target point pair has Euclidean distance at least this downward-rounded AABB lower bound. Any mathematically smaller nonnegative margin is sufficient for the directional criterion. This is not a required product margin, penetration depth or continuous-motion guarantee.
